title: RWH003: How To Win The Investing Game w/ Joel Greenblatt
summary:
How a freak investment disaster taught him never to forget that bad things happen. Why he believes that the greatest investors tend to have “a screw loose.” 
 How he handles the emotional pain and stress of investing. Why he never bought Bitcoin—and has no regrets about it.
